She is taking sertraline as prescribed, feels no difference yet, and denies side effects. Repeat EPDS: 20. She fears that if she discloses the thoughts, her baby will be taken away.
content.zh: 护士评估自杀意念、意图或计划、伤害婴儿的想法、精神病性症状、命令性幻听、照护婴儿的能力以及家庭支持。完成此评估后，患者披露关于把婴儿摔下去的侵入性想法、围绕楼梯的回避行为，以及这些想法带来的强烈痛苦。她流泪但能参与交流。她报告每晚仅断续睡2到3小时，即使婴儿能连续睡4到5小时。她尚未开始治疗。她按医嘱服用舍曲林，目前还没感觉改善，并否认副作用。复测EPDS：20分。她担心如果说出这些想法，孩子会被带走。

content.en: The client's mother, who is visiting for the week, tells the nurse privately that her daughter "hasn't been herself" and that she found her crying in the bathroom at 3 AM two nights ago because she "couldn't turn off her brain." The mother asks whether the intrusive thoughts mean her daughter is dangerous to the infant.
content.zh: 患者的母亲本周来探访，她私下告诉护士，女儿“和平时不一样”，两天前凌晨3点她发现女儿在浴室哭泣，原因是“脑子停不下来”。母亲询问这些侵入性想法是否意味着女儿对婴儿有危险。

title.en: Stage 2 - Two-week follow-up, day 19 of sertraline
title.zh: 阶段2——两周随访，舍曲林第19天

content.en: The client returns alone with the infant. She reports sertraline "might be helping a little": sleep is 3-4 hours per night and appetite is slightly better. Intrusive thoughts have not diminished and now include imagining the infant choking. She checks the infant's breathing every 15-20 minutes throughout the night, avoids bathing the infant alone because she imagines slipping underwater, and has not left the house alone with the infant since her mother left four days ago. She attended one telehealth CBT session and found discussion of intrusive thoughts versus intent "a little helpful." She denies suicidal ideation or intent to harm the infant. She appears anxious, fidgets, picks at her cuticles, and speaks with mild pressure when discussing the thoughts. PHQ-9: 16. EPDS: 18. Vital signs: T 36.9 C, HR 84, BP 122/76, RR 18, SpO2 99%.
content.zh: 患者独自带婴儿复诊。她报告舍曲林“可能有一点帮助”：每晚睡3到4小时，食欲稍有改善。侵入性想法没有减少，现在还包括想象婴儿窒息。她整晚每15到20分钟检查婴儿呼吸；因为会想象婴儿滑入水中而避免单独给婴儿洗澡；自4天前母亲离开后，她没有独自带婴儿出门。她参加了一次远程认知行为治疗，觉得关于侵入性想法与意图区别的讨论“有一点帮助”。她否认自杀意念或伤害婴儿意图。她看起来更焦虑，坐立不安，抠甲周皮肤，谈到这些想法时语速略快。PHQ-9：16分。EPDS：18分。生命体征：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率84次/分，血压122/76 mmHg，呼吸18次/分，SpO2 99%。

content.en: The client says, "I know it doesn't make sense, but I can't stop." She reports that her partner is supportive but frustrated because she wakes him repeatedly to check the baby. She asks the nurse whether the medication dose should be increased.
content.zh: 患者说：“我知道这说不通，但我停不下来。”她报告伴侣支持她，但因为她反复叫醒他检查婴儿而感到挫败。她询问护士药物剂量是否应该增加。

title.en: Stage 3 - Five-week follow-up, day 33 of sertraline; dose 100 mg daily since day 21
title.zh: 阶段3——五周随访，舍曲林第33天；第21天起剂量为每日100 mg

content.en: The client arrives with the infant in a stroller, makes eye contact, and greets the nurse by name. She reports sleeping 5-6 hours per night, eating regular meals, and taking the infant for two walks this week. Intrusive thoughts still occur but are "quieter" and less frequent, about once or twice a day rather than constantly. She no longer avoids the staircase, though she holds the railing. She has attended three CBT sessions and states that labeling thoughts as "just thoughts, not plans" is helpful. She bathed the infant alone yesterday without significant distress. EPDS: 11. PHQ-9: 10. She smiles briefly when describing the infant grasping her finger. She and her partner have a nighttime schedule so each gets a longer sleep block. She asks how long she will need to stay on medication, whether it is still safe while breastfeeding, and whether she is at risk for recurrence with a future pregnancy. Vital signs: T 36.7 C, HR 74, BP 116/70, RR 14, SpO2 99%.
content.zh: 患者推着婴儿车来诊，有眼神接触，并能叫出护士姓名打招呼。她报告每晚睡5到6小时，规律进餐，本周带婴儿外出散步两次。侵入性想法仍会出现，但“声音小了”，频率较低，从持续不断降至每天一两次。她不再回避楼梯，但仍会扶着扶手。她已参加三次认知行为治疗，并说把想法标记为“只是想法，不是计划”很有帮助。她昨天独自给婴儿洗澡，未出现明显痛苦。EPDS：11分。PHQ-9：10分。她描述婴儿抓住她手指的新习惯时短暂微笑。她和伴侣制定了夜间安排，使双方都能获得较长睡眠时段。她询问需要服药多久、母乳喂养期间继续服药是否仍安全，以及将来再次怀孕是否有复发风险。生命体征：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率74次/分，血压116/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，SpO2 99%。

stem.en: At Stage 1, classify each cue after the structured safety assessment.
stem.zh: 在阶段1完成结构化安全评估后，对每项线索进行分类。

stem.en: At Stage 1, the structured safety assessment shows no intent to harm, no psychosis, and intact ability to care for the infant. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段1，结构化安全评估显示患者无伤害意图、无精神病性症状，并且照护婴儿能力完整。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: At Stage 2, complete the clinical judgment statement about the symptom trajectory.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，完成关于症状变化轨迹的临床判断陈述。

stem.en: At Stage 2, the client asks, "Should my sertraline dose be increased?" Which response by the nurse is best?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，患者问：“我的舍曲林剂量应该增加吗？”护士的哪项回应最佳？

stem.en: At Stage 3, which statements should the nurse include when evaluating the treatment response and providing anticipatory guidance? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士评估治疗反应并提供预期指导时，应包括哪些说明？选择所有适用项。

options.en: "A history of postpartum depression can increase recurrence risk in a future pregnancy, so early screening and a prevention plan are important."
options.zh: “有产后抑郁史可能增加以后妊娠复发风险，因此早期筛查和预防计划很重要。”

options.en: "Keep using the CBT strategies and follow up with the prescriber before making any medication changes."
options.zh: “继续使用认知行为治疗策略，在做任何药物改变前先随访开药者。”

options.en: "Sertraline is commonly considered compatible with breastfeeding, but continue discussing infant and maternal monitoring with the prescriber and pediatric clinician."
options.zh: “舍曲林通常被认为与母乳喂养相容，但仍应继续与开药者和儿科医生讨论母婴监测。”

options.en: "Your sleep, appetite, functioning, screening scores, and ability to care for the baby show meaningful improvement."
options.zh: “你的睡眠、食欲、功能、筛查分数以及照护婴儿的能力都显示出有意义的改善。”

options.en: "Because you feel better, you can stop sertraline abruptly today."
options.zh: “既然你感觉好转，今天就可以突然停用舍曲林。”

options.en: "The duration of medication treatment should be individualized with the prescriber; many plans continue medication for several months after remission to reduce relapse risk."
options.zh: “用药持续时间应由你和开药者个体化决定；许多方案会在症状缓解后继续用药数月，以降低复发风险。”

correct.en: Stage 3 shows a positive but incomplete response: improved sleep, appetite, function, bonding behaviors, fewer intrusive thoughts, and lower EPDS and PHQ-9 scores. Teaching should support ongoing CBT, prescriber-guided medication decisions, breastfeeding-compatible treatment discussions, relapse prevention, and early planning for future pregnancies. Abrupt discontinuation after early improvement can increase relapse risk.
correct.zh: 阶段3显示积极但尚未完全结束的治疗反应：睡眠、食欲、功能、亲子互动行为改善，侵入性想法减少，EPDS和PHQ-9下降。宣教应支持继续认知行为治疗、由开药者指导药物决定、讨论与母乳喂养相容的治疗、预防复发，以及为未来妊娠提前计划。早期好转后突然停药可能增加复发风险。

byChoice.en: Abruptly stopping an effective antidepressant after early improvement is unsafe teaching and can increase relapse risk.
byChoice.zh: 在早期好转后突然停用有效抗抑郁药是不安全宣教，可能增加复发风险。

byChoice.en: Multiple domains have improved, so the nurse should name the specific evidence of response.
byChoice.zh: 多个领域均有改善，因此护士应指出具体的治疗反应证据。

byChoice.en: Sertraline is generally a preferred SSRI during breastfeeding; monitoring and individualized discussion remain appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 舍曲林通常是母乳喂养期间较常用的SSRI之一；仍需监测并进行个体化讨论。

byChoice.en: Treatment duration is individualized, but continuation after remission is commonly used to reduce relapse risk.
byChoice.zh: 治疗持续时间需个体化，但缓解后继续用药常用于降低复发风险。

byChoice.en: Prior postpartum depression is a recurrence risk cue, so proactive screening and planning are appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 既往产后抑郁是复发风险线索，因此主动筛查和计划是合适的。

byChoice.en: CBT strategies are helping and medication changes should be coordinated with the prescriber.
byChoice.zh: 认知行为治疗策略正在发挥作用，药物改变应与开药者协调。

testTakingStrategy.en: For outcome evaluation, look for improvement across tools and daily function, then choose teaching that prevents relapse rather than ending treatment prematurely.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估疗效时，要看量表和日常功能的多方面改善；宣教应预防复发，而不是过早结束治疗。

She attended one telehealth CBT session and found discussion of intrusive thoughts versus intent "a little helpful." She denies suicidal ideation or intent to harm the infant. She appears anxious, fidgets, picks at her cuticles, and speaks with mild pressure when discussing the thoughts. PHQ-9: 16. EPDS: 18. Vital signs: T 36.9 C, HR 84, BP 122/76, RR 18, SpO2 99%.

患者独自带婴儿复诊。她报告舍曲林“可能有一点帮助”：每晚睡3到4小时，食欲稍有改善。侵入性想法没有减少，现在还包括想象婴儿窒息。她整晚每15到20分钟检查婴儿呼吸；因为会想象婴儿滑入水中而避免单独给婴儿洗澡；自4天前母亲离开后，她没有独自带婴儿出门。她参加了一次远程认知行为治疗，觉得关于侵入性想法与意图区别的讨论“有一点帮助”。她否认自杀意念或伤害婴儿意图。她看起来更焦虑，坐立不安，抠甲周皮肤，谈到这些想法时语速略快。PHQ-9：16分。EPDS：18分。生命体征：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率84次/分，血压122/76 mmHg，呼吸18次/分，SpO2 99%。

The client says, "I know it doesn't make sense, but I can't stop." She reports that her partner is supportive but frustrated because she wakes him repeatedly to check the baby. She asks the nurse whether the medication dose should be increased.
患者说：“我知道这说不通，但我停不下来。”她报告伴侣支持她，但因为她反复叫醒他检查婴儿而感到挫败。她询问护士药物剂量是否应该增加。
Stage 2 - Two-week follow-up, day 19 of sertraline
阶段2——两周随访，舍曲林第19天

The client arrives with the infant in a stroller, makes eye contact, and greets the nurse by name. She reports sleeping 5-6 hours per night, eating regular meals, and taking the infant for two walks this week. Intrusive thoughts still occur but are "quieter" and less frequent, about once or twice a day rather than constantly. She no longer avoids the staircase, though she holds the railing. She has attended three CBT sessions and states that labeling thoughts as "just thoughts, not plans" is helpful. She bathed the infant alone yesterday without significant distress. EPDS: 11. PHQ-9: 10. She smiles briefly when describing the infant grasping her finger. She and her partner have a nighttime schedule so each gets a longer sleep block. She asks how long she will need to stay on medication, whether it is still safe while breastfeeding, and whether she is at risk for recurrence with a future pregnancy. Vital signs: T 36.7 C, HR 74, BP 116/70, RR 14, SpO2 99%.

患者推着婴儿车来诊，有眼神接触，并能叫出护士姓名打招呼。她报告每晚睡5到6小时，规律进餐，本周带婴儿外出散步两次。侵入性想法仍会出现，但“声音小了”，频率较低，从持续不断降至每天一两次。她不再回避楼梯，但仍会扶着扶手。她已参加三次认知行为治疗，并说把想法标记为“只是想法，不是计划”很有帮助。她昨天独自给婴儿洗澡，未出现明显痛苦。EPDS：11分。PHQ-9：10分。她描述婴儿抓住她手指的新习惯时短暂微笑。她和伴侣制定了夜间安排，使双方都能获得较长睡眠时段。她询问需要服药多久、母乳喂养期间继续服药是否仍安全，以及将来再次怀孕是否有复发风险。生命体征：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率74次/分，血压116/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，SpO2 99%。
Stage 3 - Five-week follow-up, day 33 of sertraline; dose 100 mg daily since day 21
阶段3——五周随访，舍曲林第33天；第21天起剂量为每日100 mg
At Stage 1, classify each cue after the structured safety assessment.
在阶段1完成结构化安全评估后，对每项线索进行分类。
At Stage 1, the structured safety assessment shows no intent to harm, no psychosis, and intact ability to care for the infant. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
在阶段1，结构化安全评估显示患者无伤害意图、无精神病性症状，并且照护婴儿能力完整。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。
At Stage 2, complete the clinical judgment statement about the symptom trajectory.
在阶段2，完成关于症状变化轨迹的临床判断陈述。
At Stage 2, the client asks, "Should my sertraline dose be increased?" Which response by the nurse is best?
在阶段2，患者问：“我的舍曲林剂量应该增加吗？”护士的哪项回应最佳？
At Stage 3, which statements should the nurse include when evaluating the treatment response and providing anticipatory guidance? Select all that apply.
在阶段3，护士评估治疗反应并提供预期指导时，应包括哪些说明？选择所有适用项。
"A history of postpartum depression can increase recurrence risk in a future pregnancy, so early screening and a prevention plan are important."
“有产后抑郁史可能增加以后妊娠复发风险，因此早期筛查和预防计划很重要。”
"Keep using the CBT strategies and follow up with the prescriber before making any medication changes."
“继续使用认知行为治疗策略，在做任何药物改变前先随访开药者。”
"Sertraline is commonly considered compatible with breastfeeding, but continue discussing infant and maternal monitoring with the prescriber and pediatric clinician."
“舍曲林通常被认为与母乳喂养相容，但仍应继续与开药者和儿科医生讨论母婴监测。”
"Your sleep, appetite, functioning, screening scores, and ability to care for the baby show meaningful improvement."
“你的睡眠、食欲、功能、筛查分数以及照护婴儿的能力都显示出有意义的改善。”
"Because you feel better, you can stop sertraline abruptly today."
“既然你感觉好转，今天就可以突然停用舍曲林。”
"The duration of medication treatment should be individualized with the prescriber; many plans continue medication for several months after remission to reduce relapse risk."
“用药持续时间应由你和开药者个体化决定；许多方案会在症状缓解后继续用药数月，以降低复发风险。”
Abruptly stopping an effective antidepressant after early improvement is unsafe teaching and can increase relapse risk.
在早期好转后突然停用有效抗抑郁药是不安全宣教，可能增加复发风险。
Multiple domains have improved, so the nurse should name the specific evidence of response.
多个领域均有改善，因此护士应指出具体的治疗反应证据。
Sertraline is generally a preferred SSRI during breastfeeding; monitoring and individualized discussion remain appropriate.
舍曲林通常是母乳喂养期间较常用的SSRI之一；仍需监测并进行个体化讨论。
Treatment duration is individualized, but continuation after remission is commonly used to reduce relapse risk.
治疗持续时间需个体化，但缓解后继续用药常用于降低复发风险。
Prior postpartum depression is a recurrence risk cue, so proactive screening and planning are appropriate.
既往产后抑郁是复发风险线索，因此主动筛查和计划是合适的。
CBT strategies are helping and medication changes should be coordinated with the prescriber.
认知行为治疗策略正在发挥作用，药物改变应与开药者协调。

Stage 3 shows a positive but incomplete response: improved sleep, appetite, function, bonding behaviors, fewer intrusive thoughts, and lower EPDS and PHQ-9 scores. Teaching should support ongoing CBT, prescriber-guided medication decisions, breastfeeding-compatible treatment discussions, relapse prevention, and early planning for future pregnancies. Abrupt discontinuation after early improvement can increase relapse risk.
阶段3显示积极但尚未完全结束的治疗反应：睡眠、食欲、功能、亲子互动行为改善，侵入性想法减少，EPDS和PHQ-9下降。宣教应支持继续认知行为治疗、由开药者指导药物决定、讨论与母乳喂养相容的治疗、预防复发，以及为未来妊娠提前计划。早期好转后突然停药可能增加复发风险。
For outcome evaluation, look for improvement across tools and daily function, then choose teaching that prevents relapse rather than ending treatment prematurely.
评估疗效时，要看量表和日常功能的多方面改善；宣教应预防复发，而不是过早结束治疗。

stem.en: Review the home health and emergency department record. Answer the case-study items about suspected elder neglect, medication mismanagement, electrolyte instability, and discharge safety.
stem.zh: 查看居家护理和急诊记录。回答关于疑似老年人疏忽照护、用药管理不当、电解质不稳定和出院安全的病例题。

title.en: Elder neglect with medication mismanagement in a home health setting
title.zh: 居家护理中的老年人疏忽照护与用药管理不当

summary.en: An 81-year-old woman with HFrEF, type 2 diabetes, mild cognitive impairment, CKD stage 3a, and a stage II sacral pressure injury is seen by home health 10 days after discharge for heart failure. Her adult son is the listed caregiver. The nurse finds clinical decline, poor intake, inconsistent medication use, no monitoring logs, and a worsened pressure injury.
summary.zh: 一名81岁女性患有射血分数降低型心力衰竭、2型糖尿病、轻度认知障碍、3a期慢性肾病和骶尾部II期压力性损伤。因心衰住院后出院10天，居家护士进行随访。其成年儿子为主要照护者。护士发现患者病情恶化、进食饮水不足、用药不一致、没有监测记录，且压力性损伤加重。

title.en: Discharge background and ordered home health services
title.zh: 出院背景与居家护理医嘱

content.en:
History: HFrEF with EF 30%, type 2 diabetes, hypertension, mild cognitive impairment, CKD stage 3a with baseline eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73 m2, and stage II sacral pressure injury at discharge measuring 2 cm x 1.5 cm.
Discharge medications: furosemide 40 mg PO twice daily, lisinopril 10 mg PO daily, carvedilol 12.5 mg PO twice daily, potassium chloride 20 mEq PO daily, insulin glargine 18 units SubQ at bedtime, metformin 500 mg PO twice daily.
Home health order: visit three times weekly for medication reconciliation, heart failure assessment, and pressure injury monitoring.
Caregiver teaching before discharge: medication schedule, daily weight, blood glucose monitoring, sodium restriction, and repositioning schedule.
content.zh:
病史：射血分数降低型心力衰竭，EF 30%；2型糖尿病；高血压；轻度认知障碍；3a期慢性肾病，基线eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73 m2；出院时骶尾部II期压力性损伤，大小2 cm x 1.5 cm。
出院用药：呋塞米40 mg口服每日2次，赖诺普利10 mg口服每日1次，卡维地洛12.5 mg口服每日2次，氯化钾20 mEq口服每日1次，甘精胰岛素18单位睡前皮下注射，二甲双胍500 mg口服每日2次。
居家护理医嘱：每周3次上门，进行用药核对、心衰评估和压力性损伤监测。
出院前照护者教育：用药时间表、每日体重、血糖监测、限钠饮食和翻身减压计划。

title.zh: 出院后第10天居家随访评估

content.en:
The son says the client is doing fine but sleeping a lot. He is vague about which medications are given and has not checked blood glucose or daily weights. The client is drowsy but arousable, oriented to person/place, weak, and reports little food or fluid intake for several days. She has been sitting in the recliner most of the time and smells faintly of urine.
Vitals: T 36.4 C, HR 54, BP 92/58, RR 18, SpO2 94% room air. No functioning home scale. Dry oral mucosa, poor skin turgor, sunken eyes, capillary refill 4 seconds. No lower-extremity edema. Faint bibasilar crackles. Maximal assistance needed to rise. Strength 3/5 in all extremities.
Sacral wound: now about 3 cm x 2.5 cm, deeper than at discharge, pale wound bed, macerated rim, moderate serous drainage on cushion. Soiled incontinence brief reportedly unchanged since the previous evening.
Medication evidence: furosemide bottle nearly empty; potassium chloride bottle nearly full; insulin pen appears unused; metformin bottle has an appropriate number of pills missing. Son becomes defensive when asked about the medication schedule.
content.zh:
儿子表示患者还好，只是睡得多。他说不清具体给了哪些药，也没有测血糖或每日体重。患者嗜睡但呼之可醒，能说出人和地点，感到虚弱，称几天来进食饮水很少。她大部分时间坐在躺椅上，衣物有轻微尿味。
生命体征：T 36.4 C，HR 54，BP 92/58，RR 18，室内空气SpO2 94%。家中无可用体重秤。口腔黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、眼窝凹陷、毛细血管再充盈4秒。双下肢无水肿。双肺底轻微湿啰音。起身需最大协助。四肢肌力3/5。
骶尾部伤口：约3 cm x 2.5 cm，较出院时更深，创面苍白，周缘浸渍，坐垫上有中等量浆液性渗液。患者称失禁尿裤从前一晚起未更换。
用药证据：呋塞米瓶几乎空了；氯化钾瓶几乎满；胰岛素笔看似未使用；二甲双胍瓶缺少的片数与服用相符。询问用药时间表时，儿子变得防御。

title.zh: 第10天稍后返回的化验结果

content.en:
Fingerstick blood glucose at visit: 268 mg/dL.
Serum labs: sodium 149 mEq/L, potassium 2.9 mEq/L, chloride 98 mEq/L, CO2 30 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL with baseline 1.2, eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2, magnesium 1.4 mEq/L, albumin 2.6 g/dL, prealbumin 11 mg/dL. A1c drawn at discharge was 8.4%.
content.zh:
随访时指尖血糖：268 mg/dL。
血液化验：钠149 mEq/L，钾2.9 mEq/L，氯98 mEq/L，CO2 30 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL，肌酐1.8 mg/dL，基线1.2，eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2，镁1.4 mEq/L，白蛋白2.6 g/dL，前白蛋白11 mg/dL。出院时糖化血红蛋白8.4%。

title.zh: 阶段1 - 居家随访处置

content.en: The nurse recognizes a pattern of dehydration, malnutrition, medication mismanagement, immobility, soiled clothing, worsening pressure injury, and caregiver inability to describe the care plan. The nurse contacts the home health agency supervisor and primary care provider. The provider directs emergency department evaluation for electrolyte derangements, dehydration, and acute kidney injury. The nurse initiates the agency mandatory reporting protocol for suspected elder neglect according to state law and facility policy.
content.zh: 护士识别出脱水、营养不良、用药管理不当、长期不活动、衣物污浊、压力性损伤恶化，以及照护者无法说明照护计划等模式。护士联系居家护理机构主管和初级保健提供者。提供者指示转急诊评估电解质紊乱、脱水和急性肾损伤。护士按照州法律和机构政策启动机构关于疑似老年人疏忽照护的强制报告流程。

title.en: Stage 2 - Emergency department, about 3 hours later
title.zh: 阶段2 - 约3小时后急诊

content.en:
The client is more lethargic, oriented only to person, and reports muscle weakness and palpitations. Vitals: T 36.2 C, HR 48, BP 88/52, RR 20, SpO2 93% room air. Telemetry shows sinus bradycardia with prominent U waves and flattened T waves; ECG confirms prolonged QT interval.
Orders: 500 mL normal saline bolus; potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL NS IV over 1 hour through a peripheral line using an infusion pump; ED protocol limits peripheral potassium to 10 mEq/hr and no more than 10 mEq/100 mL with continuous telemetry. Magnesium sulfate 2 g IV over 1 hour. Hold furosemide and carvedilol pending stabilization. Fingerstick glucose every 4 hours with low-dose correction insulin per sliding scale; standing glargine held by provider order until intake and clinical picture stabilize. Repeat labs after potassium infusion. Home health APS referral is active; ED social worker begins parallel assessment.
content.zh:
患者更加嗜睡，仅能说出自己是谁，并诉肌无力和心悸。生命体征：T 36.2 C，HR 48，BP 88/52，RR 20，室内空气SpO2 93%。心电监护示窦性心动过缓，明显U波和T波低平；12导联心电图证实QT间期延长。
医嘱：0.9%氯化钠500 mL快速补液；氯化钾10 mEq加入100 mL NS，经外周静脉用输液泵1小时输注；急诊方案规定外周补钾不超过10 mEq/hr，浓度不超过10 mEq/100 mL，并持续心电监护。硫酸镁2 g静脉1小时输注。呋塞米和卡维地洛暂缓，待血流动力学稳定。每4小时测指尖血糖，并按滑动量表给予低剂量纠正胰岛素；提供者医嘱在进食和临床情况稳定前暂缓常规甘精胰岛素。补钾后复查化验。居家护理已启动APS转介；急诊社工同步评估。

title.en: Stage 3 - Six hours after ED arrival
title.zh: 阶段3 - 急诊到达后6小时

title.en: Response to initial treatment and ongoing plan
title.zh: 初始治疗反应与后续计划

content.en:
After normal saline, IV potassium, and IV magnesium: sodium 146 mEq/L, potassium 3.4 mEq/L, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m2, magnesium 1.8 mEq/L, blood glucose 198 mg/dL. Vitals: T 36.6 C, HR 62, BP 100/64, RR 18, SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. Telemetry now shows normal sinus rhythm; U waves have resolved and QT interval has shortened. Client is more alert and takes small sips. Urine output over 4 hours is 120 mL.
Provider orders additional potassium replacement per facility protocol and continued IV fluids at 100 mL/hr. Wound care documents worsened stage II sacral injury, 3 cm x 2.5 cm with pale base, consistent with sustained pressure and poor nutrition. Pressure redistribution mattress and repositioning every 2 hours are initiated. APS referral remains active; a care conference is being arranged to evaluate discharge safety. Because eGFR dropped to 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 during the acute kidney injury, metformin is discontinued and will not be resumed unless renal function is reassessed and the provider clears it.
content.zh:
补充0.9%氯化钠、静脉补钾和静脉补镁后：钠146 mEq/L，钾3.4 mEq/L，肌酐1.6 mg/dL，eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m2，镁1.8 mEq/L，血糖198 mg/dL。生命体征：T 36.6 C，HR 62，BP 100/64，RR 18，鼻导管2 L氧气下SpO2 96%。心电监护现为正常窦性心律；U波消失，QT间期缩短。患者更清醒，可少量饮水。4小时尿量120 mL。
提供者按机构方案开立继续补钾和100 mL/hr维持静脉输液。伤口护理护士记录骶尾部II期压力性损伤恶化，3 cm x 2.5 cm，创面苍白，符合持续受压和营养不良。已使用减压床垫，并启动每2小时翻身。APS转介仍在进行；正在安排护理会议评估出院安全。由于急性肾损伤期间eGFR曾降至28 mL/min/1.73 m2，二甲双胍已停用；除非重新评估肾功能且提供者批准，否则不恢复使用。

stem.en: At the first home visit, classify each finding according to whether it supports suspected elder neglect by the responsible caregiver or is primarily a medical finding that still requires follow-up.
stem.zh: 在第一次居家随访时，将每项发现分类为支持怀疑主要照护者存在老年人疏忽照护，或主要属于仍需跟进的医学发现。

stem.en: Which medication-related problem is the most immediate safety priority at the first home visit?
stem.zh: 第一次居家随访时，哪一项用药相关问题是最紧急的安全优先事项？

stem.en: After completing the first home assessment, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 完成第一次居家评估后，哪些护理措施是合适的？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the nurse reviews the provider order to discontinue metformin because the client's eGFR dropped to 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 during the acute kidney injury. Which interpretation is best?
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士复核提供者因患者急性肾损伤期间eGFR降至28 mL/min/1.73 m2而停用二甲双胍的医嘱。哪项理解最恰当？

stem.en: At Stage 3, which findings show that continued monitoring or interdisciplinary planning is still needed before discharge back to the same home environment? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，哪些发现表明在出院回到同一家庭环境前仍需继续监测或跨专业计划？选择所有适用项。

options.en: U waves resolved and the QT interval shortened
options.zh: U波消失，QT间期缩短

options.en: Blood pressure and heart rate improved after treatment
options.zh: 治疗后血压和心率改善

options.en: APS referral and safe-discharge care conference are still in progress
options.zh: APS转介和安全出院护理会议仍在进行中

options.en: Potassium improved to 3.4 mEq/L but remains below the usual normal range
options.zh: 钾改善至3.4 mEq/L，但仍低于通常正常范围

options.en: Creatinine remains above the client's baseline after initial fluids
options.zh: 初始补液后肌酐仍高于患者基线

options.en: The pressure injury is still worsened and nutrition markers are low
options.zh: 压力性损伤仍然恶化，营养指标偏低

correct.en: The client is improving, but improvement is not resolution. Potassium remains low, kidney function has not returned to baseline, the wound and nutrition deficits need active treatment, and the protective services/discharge-safety process is unresolved. Resolved U waves and improved vital signs are reassuring response cues, not reasons to stop planning.
correct.zh: 患者正在改善，但改善不等于问题完全解决。钾仍偏低，肾功能尚未回到基线，伤口和营养缺陷仍需积极处理，保护服务和出院安全流程尚未完成。U波消失和生命体征改善是令人放心的治疗反应线索，而不是停止计划的理由。

byChoice.en: Resolution of U waves and QT shortening indicate improvement in the acute cardiac effect of hypokalemia.
byChoice.zh: U波消失和QT间期缩短提示低钾的急性心脏影响正在改善。

byChoice.en: Creatinine 1.6 mg/dL remains above the 1.2 mg/dL baseline, so kidney recovery and medication safety need follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐1.6 mg/dL仍高于1.2 mg/dL基线，因此肾功能恢复和用药安全需继续跟进。

byChoice.en: A worsened pressure injury with low albumin/prealbumin requires wound care, nutrition support, and pressure relief planning.
byChoice.zh: 压力性损伤恶化并伴白蛋白/前白蛋白低，需要伤口护理、营养支持和减压计划。

byChoice.en: A potassium of 3.4 mEq/L is improved but still requires monitoring and ordered replacement.
byChoice.zh: 钾3.4 mEq/L虽有改善，但仍需监测并按医嘱补充。

byChoice.en: The client should not be sent back to the same unsafe pattern without interdisciplinary assessment of discharge safety.
byChoice.zh: 在未跨专业评估出院安全前，不应让患者回到同样不安全的照护模式。

byChoice.en: Improved heart rate and blood pressure are positive response findings, but they do not by themselves identify an unresolved discharge barrier.
byChoice.zh: 心率和血压改善是积极反应，但本身并不代表未解决的出院障碍。

testTakingStrategy.en: In outcome-evaluation items, distinguish response to treatment from full readiness for discharge; persistent physiologic, wound, nutrition, and safety risks still matter.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做结局评估题时，要区分治疗有反应和完全可出院；持续存在的生理、伤口、营养和安全风险仍然重要。

stem.en: In the emergency department, the provider orders potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL NS over 1 hour through a peripheral IV. Which nursing actions are appropriate before and during administration? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在急诊，提供者开立氯化钾10 mEq加入100 mL NS，经外周静脉1小时输注。给药前和给药过程中哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Use an infusion pump for the potassium infusion
options.zh: 使用输液泵输注氯化钾

options.en: Continue to monitor rhythm, repeat labs as ordered, and assess for signs of overcorrection
options.zh: 继续监测心律、按医嘱复查化验，并评估是否出现纠正过度的迹象

options.en: Confirm that magnesium replacement is being administered as ordered
options.zh: 确认镁剂补充正按医嘱执行

options.en: Give the dose by IV push because the potassium is severely low
options.zh: 因钾严重偏低而静脉推注该剂量

options.en: Monitor the peripheral IV site for pain, infiltration, or phlebitis
options.zh: 监测外周静脉部位是否疼痛、渗漏或静脉炎

options.en: Verify continuous telemetry is active before starting the infusion
options.zh: 开始输注前确认持续心电监护已开启

correct.en: The order matches the ED protocol stated in the case: 10 mEq/hr and 10 mEq/100 mL through a peripheral line, using an infusion pump with continuous telemetry. The nurse also monitors the IV site, rhythm, and follow-up labs. Magnesium repletion supports potassium correction when magnesium is low. IV push potassium is unsafe.
correct.zh: 该医嘱符合病例中列出的急诊方案：外周静脉10 mEq/hr，浓度10 mEq/100 mL，使用输液泵并持续心电监护。护士还需监测静脉部位、心律和后续化验。低镁时补镁有助于纠正低钾。静脉推注氯化钾不安全。

byChoice.en: An infusion pump controls the rate and reduces the risk of rapid potassium administration.
byChoice.zh: 输液泵可控制速度，降低钾输注过快的风险。

byChoice.en: Peripheral potassium can irritate veins; site monitoring helps detect infiltration or phlebitis early.
byChoice.zh: 外周补钾可刺激静脉；监测穿刺部位可及早发现渗漏或静脉炎。

byChoice.en: Low magnesium can make potassium correction difficult; the ordered magnesium replacement is part of safe electrolyte management.
byChoice.zh: 低镁会使低钾难以纠正；医嘱补镁是安全管理电解质的一部分。

byChoice.en: Telemetry is required by the stated ED protocol and is appropriate because hypokalemia affects cardiac conduction.
byChoice.zh: 病例中的急诊方案要求心电监护；低钾影响心脏传导，因此需要监护。

byChoice.en: IV push potassium can cause life-threatening arrhythmias and is not appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 静脉推注钾可导致危及生命的心律失常，不合适。

byChoice.en: Follow-up monitoring detects response to treatment and signs of excessive potassium replacement.
byChoice.zh: 后续监测可发现治疗反应以及补钾过度迹象。

testTakingStrategy.en: For high-alert IV electrolytes, check the prescribed concentration, route, rate-control device, monitoring, and follow-up labs before focusing on less urgent tasks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理高警示静脉电解质时，先核对浓度、途径、速度控制设备、监测和复查化验，再考虑次要任务。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the home health and emergency department record. Answer the case-study items about suspected elder neglect, medication mismanagement, electrolyte instability, and discharge safety.
查看居家护理和急诊记录。回答关于疑似老年人疏忽照护、用药管理不当、电解质不稳定和出院安全的病例题。
Elder neglect with medication mismanagement in a home health setting
居家护理中的老年人疏忽照护与用药管理不当

An 81-year-old woman with HFrEF, type 2 diabetes, mild cognitive impairment, CKD stage 3a, and a stage II sacral pressure injury is seen by home health 10 days after discharge for heart failure. Her adult son is the listed caregiver. The nurse finds clinical decline, poor intake, inconsistent medication use, no monitoring logs, and a worsened pressure injury.
一名81岁女性患有射血分数降低型心力衰竭、2型糖尿病、轻度认知障碍、3a期慢性肾病和骶尾部II期压力性损伤。因心衰住院后出院10天，居家护士进行随访。其成年儿子为主要照护者。护士发现患者病情恶化、进食饮水不足、用药不一致、没有监测记录，且压力性损伤加重。

History: HFrEF with EF 30%, type 2 diabetes, hypertension, mild cognitive impairment, CKD stage 3a with baseline eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73 m2, and stage II sacral pressure injury at discharge measuring 2 cm x 1.5 cm.
Discharge medications: furosemide 40 mg PO twice daily, lisinopril 10 mg PO daily, carvedilol 12.5 mg PO twice daily, potassium chloride 20 mEq PO daily, insulin glargine 18 units SubQ at bedtime, metformin 500 mg PO twice daily.
Home health order: visit three times weekly for medication reconciliation, heart failure assessment, and pressure injury monitoring.
Caregiver teaching before discharge: medication schedule, daily weight, blood glucose monitoring, sodium restriction, and repositioning schedule.

病史：射血分数降低型心力衰竭，EF 30%；2型糖尿病；高血压；轻度认知障碍；3a期慢性肾病，基线eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73 m2；出院时骶尾部II期压力性损伤，大小2 cm x 1.5 cm。
出院用药：呋塞米40 mg口服每日2次，赖诺普利10 mg口服每日1次，卡维地洛12.5 mg口服每日2次，氯化钾20 mEq口服每日1次，甘精胰岛素18单位睡前皮下注射，二甲双胍500 mg口服每日2次。
居家护理医嘱：每周3次上门，进行用药核对、心衰评估和压力性损伤监测。
出院前照护者教育：用药时间表、每日体重、血糖监测、限钠饮食和翻身减压计划。
Discharge background and ordered home health services
出院背景与居家护理医嘱

The son says the client is doing fine but sleeping a lot. He is vague about which medications are given and has not checked blood glucose or daily weights. The client is drowsy but arousable, oriented to person/place, weak, and reports little food or fluid intake for several days. She has been sitting in the recliner most of the time and smells faintly of urine.
Vitals: T 36.4 C, HR 54, BP 92/58, RR 18, SpO2 94% room air. No functioning home scale. Dry oral mucosa, poor skin turgor, sunken eyes, capillary refill 4 seconds. No lower-extremity edema. Faint bibasilar crackles. Maximal assistance needed to rise. Strength 3/5 in all extremities.
Sacral wound: now about 3 cm x 2.5 cm, deeper than at discharge, pale wound bed, macerated rim, moderate serous drainage on cushion. Soiled incontinence brief reportedly unchanged since the previous evening.
Medication evidence: furosemide bottle nearly empty; potassium chloride bottle nearly full; insulin pen appears unused; metformin bottle has an appropriate number of pills missing. Son becomes defensive when asked about the medication schedule.

儿子表示患者还好，只是睡得多。他说不清具体给了哪些药，也没有测血糖或每日体重。患者嗜睡但呼之可醒，能说出人和地点，感到虚弱，称几天来进食饮水很少。她大部分时间坐在躺椅上，衣物有轻微尿味。
生命体征：T 36.4 C，HR 54，BP 92/58，RR 18，室内空气SpO2 94%。家中无可用体重秤。口腔黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、眼窝凹陷、毛细血管再充盈4秒。双下肢无水肿。双肺底轻微湿啰音。起身需最大协助。四肢肌力3/5。
骶尾部伤口：约3 cm x 2.5 cm，较出院时更深，创面苍白，周缘浸渍，坐垫上有中等量浆液性渗液。患者称失禁尿裤从前一晚起未更换。
用药证据：呋塞米瓶几乎空了；氯化钾瓶几乎满；胰岛素笔看似未使用；二甲双胍瓶缺少的片数与服用相符。询问用药时间表时，儿子变得防御。
出院后第10天居家随访评估

Fingerstick blood glucose at visit: 268 mg/dL.
Serum labs: sodium 149 mEq/L, potassium 2.9 mEq/L, chloride 98 mEq/L, CO2 30 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL with baseline 1.2, eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2, magnesium 1.4 mEq/L, albumin 2.6 g/dL, prealbumin 11 mg/dL. A1c drawn at discharge was 8.4%.

随访时指尖血糖：268 mg/dL。
血液化验：钠149 mEq/L，钾2.9 mEq/L，氯98 mEq/L，CO2 30 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL，肌酐1.8 mg/dL，基线1.2，eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2，镁1.4 mEq/L，白蛋白2.6 g/dL，前白蛋白11 mg/dL。出院时糖化血红蛋白8.4%。
第10天稍后返回的化验结果

The nurse recognizes a pattern of dehydration, malnutrition, medication mismanagement, immobility, soiled clothing, worsening pressure injury, and caregiver inability to describe the care plan. The nurse contacts the home health agency supervisor and primary care provider. The provider directs emergency department evaluation for electrolyte derangements, dehydration, and acute kidney injury. The nurse initiates the agency mandatory reporting protocol for suspected elder neglect according to state law and facility policy.
护士识别出脱水、营养不良、用药管理不当、长期不活动、衣物污浊、压力性损伤恶化，以及照护者无法说明照护计划等模式。护士联系居家护理机构主管和初级保健提供者。提供者指示转急诊评估电解质紊乱、脱水和急性肾损伤。护士按照州法律和机构政策启动机构关于疑似老年人疏忽照护的强制报告流程。
阶段1 - 居家随访处置

The client is more lethargic, oriented only to person, and reports muscle weakness and palpitations. Vitals: T 36.2 C, HR 48, BP 88/52, RR 20, SpO2 93% room air. Telemetry shows sinus bradycardia with prominent U waves and flattened T waves; ECG confirms prolonged QT interval.
Orders: 500 mL normal saline bolus; potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL NS IV over 1 hour through a peripheral line using an infusion pump; ED protocol limits peripheral potassium to 10 mEq/hr and no more than 10 mEq/100 mL with continuous telemetry. Magnesium sulfate 2 g IV over 1 hour. Hold furosemide and carvedilol pending stabilization. Fingerstick glucose every 4 hours with low-dose correction insulin per sliding scale; standing glargine held by provider order until intake and clinical picture stabilize. Repeat labs after potassium infusion. Home health APS referral is active; ED social worker begins parallel assessment.

患者更加嗜睡，仅能说出自己是谁，并诉肌无力和心悸。生命体征：T 36.2 C，HR 48，BP 88/52，RR 20，室内空气SpO2 93%。心电监护示窦性心动过缓，明显U波和T波低平；12导联心电图证实QT间期延长。
医嘱：0.9%氯化钠500 mL快速补液；氯化钾10 mEq加入100 mL NS，经外周静脉用输液泵1小时输注；急诊方案规定外周补钾不超过10 mEq/hr，浓度不超过10 mEq/100 mL，并持续心电监护。硫酸镁2 g静脉1小时输注。呋塞米和卡维地洛暂缓，待血流动力学稳定。每4小时测指尖血糖，并按滑动量表给予低剂量纠正胰岛素；提供者医嘱在进食和临床情况稳定前暂缓常规甘精胰岛素。补钾后复查化验。居家护理已启动APS转介；急诊社工同步评估。
Stage 2 - Emergency department, about 3 hours later
阶段2 - 约3小时后急诊

After normal saline, IV potassium, and IV magnesium: sodium 146 mEq/L, potassium 3.4 mEq/L, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m2, magnesium 1.8 mEq/L, blood glucose 198 mg/dL. Vitals: T 36.6 C, HR 62, BP 100/64, RR 18, SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. Telemetry now shows normal sinus rhythm; U waves have resolved and QT interval has shortened. Client is more alert and takes small sips. Urine output over 4 hours is 120 mL.
Provider orders additional potassium replacement per facility protocol and continued IV fluids at 100 mL/hr. Wound care documents worsened stage II sacral injury, 3 cm x 2.5 cm with pale base, consistent with sustained pressure and poor nutrition. Pressure redistribution mattress and repositioning every 2 hours are initiated. APS referral remains active; a care conference is being arranged to evaluate discharge safety. Because eGFR dropped to 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 during the acute kidney injury, metformin is discontinued and will not be resumed unless renal function is reassessed and the provider clears it.

补充0.9%氯化钠、静脉补钾和静脉补镁后：钠146 mEq/L，钾3.4 mEq/L，肌酐1.6 mg/dL，eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m2，镁1.8 mEq/L，血糖198 mg/dL。生命体征：T 36.6 C，HR 62，BP 100/64，RR 18，鼻导管2 L氧气下SpO2 96%。心电监护现为正常窦性心律；U波消失，QT间期缩短。患者更清醒，可少量饮水。4小时尿量120 mL。
提供者按机构方案开立继续补钾和100 mL/hr维持静脉输液。伤口护理护士记录骶尾部II期压力性损伤恶化，3 cm x 2.5 cm，创面苍白，符合持续受压和营养不良。已使用减压床垫，并启动每2小时翻身。APS转介仍在进行；正在安排护理会议评估出院安全。由于急性肾损伤期间eGFR曾降至28 mL/min/1.73 m2，二甲双胍已停用；除非重新评估肾功能且提供者批准，否则不恢复使用。
Response to initial treatment and ongoing plan
初始治疗反应与后续计划
Stage 3 - Six hours after ED arrival
阶段3 - 急诊到达后6小时
At the first home visit, classify each finding according to whether it supports suspected elder neglect by the responsible caregiver or is primarily a medical finding that still requires follow-up.
在第一次居家随访时，将每项发现分类为支持怀疑主要照护者存在老年人疏忽照护，或主要属于仍需跟进的医学发现。
Which medication-related problem is the most immediate safety priority at the first home visit?
第一次居家随访时，哪一项用药相关问题是最紧急的安全优先事项？
After completing the first home assessment, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
完成第一次居家评估后，哪些护理措施是合适的？选择所有适用项。
At Stage 3, the nurse reviews the provider order to discontinue metformin because the client's eGFR dropped to 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 during the acute kidney injury. Which interpretation is best?
在阶段3，护士复核提供者因患者急性肾损伤期间eGFR降至28 mL/min/1.73 m2而停用二甲双胍的医嘱。哪项理解最恰当？

In the emergency department, the provider orders potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL NS over 1 hour through a peripheral IV. Which nursing actions are appropriate before and during administration? Select all that apply.
在急诊，提供者开立氯化钾10 mEq加入100 mL NS，经外周静脉1小时输注。给药前和给药过程中哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。
Use an infusion pump for the potassium infusion
使用输液泵输注氯化钾
Continue to monitor rhythm, repeat labs as ordered, and assess for signs of overcorrection
继续监测心律、按医嘱复查化验，并评估是否出现纠正过度的迹象
Confirm that magnesium replacement is being administered as ordered
确认镁剂补充正按医嘱执行
Give the dose by IV push because the potassium is severely low
因钾严重偏低而静脉推注该剂量
Monitor the peripheral IV site for pain, infiltration, or phlebitis
监测外周静脉部位是否疼痛、渗漏或静脉炎
Verify continuous telemetry is active before starting the infusion
开始输注前确认持续心电监护已开启
An infusion pump controls the rate and reduces the risk of rapid potassium administration.
输液泵可控制速度，降低钾输注过快的风险。
Peripheral potassium can irritate veins; site monitoring helps detect infiltration or phlebitis early.
外周补钾可刺激静脉；监测穿刺部位可及早发现渗漏或静脉炎。
Low magnesium can make potassium correction difficult; the ordered magnesium replacement is part of safe electrolyte management.
低镁会使低钾难以纠正；医嘱补镁是安全管理电解质的一部分。
Telemetry is required by the stated ED protocol and is appropriate because hypokalemia affects cardiac conduction.
病例中的急诊方案要求心电监护；低钾影响心脏传导，因此需要监护。
IV push potassium can cause life-threatening arrhythmias and is not appropriate.
静脉推注钾可导致危及生命的心律失常，不合适。
Follow-up monitoring detects response to treatment and signs of excessive potassium replacement.
后续监测可发现治疗反应以及补钾过度迹象。

The order matches the ED protocol stated in the case: 10 mEq/hr and 10 mEq/100 mL through a peripheral line, using an infusion pump with continuous telemetry. The nurse also monitors the IV site, rhythm, and follow-up labs. Magnesium repletion supports potassium correction when magnesium is low. IV push potassium is unsafe.
该医嘱符合病例中列出的急诊方案：外周静脉10 mEq/hr，浓度10 mEq/100 mL，使用输液泵并持续心电监护。护士还需监测静脉部位、心律和后续化验。低镁时补镁有助于纠正低钾。静脉推注氯化钾不安全。
For high-alert IV electrolytes, check the prescribed concentration, route, rate-control device, monitoring, and follow-up labs before focusing on less urgent tasks.
处理高警示静脉电解质时，先核对浓度、途径、速度控制设备、监测和复查化验，再考虑次要任务。
At Stage 3, which findings show that continued monitoring or interdisciplinary planning is still needed before discharge back to the same home environment? Select all that apply.
在阶段3，哪些发现表明在出院回到同一家庭环境前仍需继续监测或跨专业计划？选择所有适用项。
U waves resolved and the QT interval shortened
Blood pressure and heart rate improved after treatment
治疗后血压和心率改善
APS referral and safe-discharge care conference are still in progress
APS转介和安全出院护理会议仍在进行中
Potassium improved to 3.4 mEq/L but remains below the usual normal range
钾改善至3.4 mEq/L，但仍低于通常正常范围
Creatinine remains above the client's baseline after initial fluids
初始补液后肌酐仍高于患者基线
The pressure injury is still worsened and nutrition markers are low
压力性损伤仍然恶化，营养指标偏低
Resolution of U waves and QT shortening indicate improvement in the acute cardiac effect of hypokalemia.
U波消失和QT间期缩短提示低钾的急性心脏影响正在改善。
Creatinine 1.6 mg/dL remains above the 1.2 mg/dL baseline, so kidney recovery and medication safety need follow-up.
肌酐1.6 mg/dL仍高于1.2 mg/dL基线，因此肾功能恢复和用药安全需继续跟进。
A worsened pressure injury with low albumin/prealbumin requires wound care, nutrition support, and pressure relief planning.
压力性损伤恶化并伴白蛋白/前白蛋白低，需要伤口护理、营养支持和减压计划。
A potassium of 3.4 mEq/L is improved but still requires monitoring and ordered replacement.
钾3.4 mEq/L虽有改善，但仍需监测并按医嘱补充。
The client should not be sent back to the same unsafe pattern without interdisciplinary assessment of discharge safety.
在未跨专业评估出院安全前，不应让患者回到同样不安全的照护模式。
Improved heart rate and blood pressure are positive response findings, but they do not by themselves identify an unresolved discharge barrier.
心率和血压改善是积极反应，但本身并不代表未解决的出院障碍。

The client is improving, but improvement is not resolution. Potassium remains low, kidney function has not returned to baseline, the wound and nutrition deficits need active treatment, and the protective services/discharge-safety process is unresolved. Resolved U waves and improved vital signs are reassuring response cues, not reasons to stop planning.
患者正在改善，但改善不等于问题完全解决。钾仍偏低，肾功能尚未回到基线，伤口和营养缺陷仍需积极处理，保护服务和出院安全流程尚未完成。U波消失和生命体征改善是令人放心的治疗反应线索，而不是停止计划的理由。
In outcome-evaluation items, distinguish response to treatment from full readiness for discharge; persistent physiologic, wound, nutrition, and safety risks still matter.
做结局评估题时，要区分治疗有反应和完全可出院；持续存在的生理、伤口、营养和安全风险仍然重要。
